goal: Obtain fresh explicit Product Lead authorization for one bounded source acquisition using the independently accepted immutable v5 freeze.
scope: User reviews the concrete authorization request and exact accepted v5 freeze; reply determines authority for one separately dispatched fresh acquisition.
Leader records exact user reply and pins only after explicit authorization, then separately verifies input/freeze mapping before dispatch.
out_of_scope: No developer dispatch, raw metadata/body/source read, request, input creation or live execution before user authorization.
No old-run continuation, scope/parser/seed/budget relaxation, build/dependency/model/integration, CP2/CP3/Alpha approval.
acceptance: Explicit Product Lead approval binds the request and accepted freeze, original design/source identities,9seeds,96files/1MiB and all original stops.
Original user reply is recorded without inference from silence or generic historic continuation.
evidence_required: Exact user reply, authorization-request hash, freeze/acceptance mapping and separate new developer task only after approval.
stop_conditions: Missing, ambiguous, narrowed or declined approval; freeze/source/contract drift; any request to bypass formal limits.
